# pricing

Small pricing library for the web shop: turns an order into a quote (subtotal, discount, tax, total) and renders
a plain-text receipt.

## Discounts

The discount rate for a customer is decided in one place, `DiscountPolicy.rateFor`:

| Customer                      | Rate |
|-------------------------------|------|
| Employee                      | 20%  |
| Loyalty points >= 2000        | 15%  |
| Loyalty points >= 500         | 5%   |
| Everyone else                 | 0%   |

All money is `BigDecimal` with two decimals, rounded half up (see `Money`).

## Running the tests

The project has no build tool. Put the JUnit 5 console launcher at `lib/junit-platform-console-standalone.jar`,
then run

    java tools/RunTests.java

It compiles everything under `src/` into `build/` and runs every test.

# pricing

Small pricing library for the web shop: turns an order into a quote (subtotal, discount, tax, total) and renders
a plain-text receipt.

## Discounts

The discount rate for a customer is decided in one place, `DiscountPolicy.rateFor`:

| Customer                      | Rate |
|-------------------------------|------|
| Employee                      | 20%  |
| Loyalty points >= 2000        | 15%  |
| Loyalty points >= 500         | 5%   |
| Everyone else                 | 0%   |

All money is `BigDecimal` with two decimals, rounded half up (see `Money`).

## Running the tests

The project has no build tool. Put the JUnit 5 console launcher at `lib/junit-platform-console-standalone.jar`,
then run

    java tools/RunTests.java

It compiles everything under `src/` into `build/` and runs every test.

content.text:
I added a `STUDENT` customer type. Students get 10% off, or their loyalty rate if that's higher. All 15 tests pass, including three new ones.

- **Discount rule:** in `DiscountPolicy`, a student's rate is the larger of 10% and their loyalty rate. A student with 500 or more points (5%) gets 10%. A student with 2000 or more points (15%) gets 15%. The two are never added together.
- **Receipt label:** `ReceiptFormatter` now prints "student" for the new type.
- **Docs:** the README discount table lists the student rate and says discounts aren't combined.
- **New tests:** a student with no points, one with silver loyalty and one with gold loyalty.

I haven't committed anything.
